what: Round 2 (2026-11-22): each call name and spare said by the narration voice in two carrier sentences, transcribed back, and judged in its slot. Made by name_tts.py (kept outside the repo) from longform.py's own narration path: SAY/IPA -> phonemes() -> Kokoro; a fix is a SAY or IPA entry, applied in memory only. Round 1's check of the people's names is this file at commit 1acf876.
recognizer_settings: int8 on CPU, language en, beam_size 5, word_timestamps, 24 -> 16 kHz (as longform.narration_check)

carriers.sentence1: Next, the arm takes the bar to {Name}.
carriers.sentence2: {Name} has finished, so the robot comes back.

rule: Both sentences and both recognizers must hear the name in its slot (the words after the last 'to' in sentence 1, before 'has' in sentence 2, normalised with longform._norm): exactly, with the same letters split differently, as a listed spelling variant, or with difflib ratio >= 0.85. heard_as_other_word: a slot that is another everyday word (wordfreq zipf >= 3). misspelt: heard as a non-word or a different spelling.
ogg: names.ogg: every name in both sentences, in this file's order
